## Welcome to the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge!

Get ready to explore The Next Frontier! Register to join us on November 14-15.

Step 01

## CREATE ACCOUNT

August 26, 2026

The first step in your hackathon journey is to create a NASA Space Apps account or log in to your existing account.

Create Account

Step 02

## REGISTER FOR THE HACKATHON

August 26, 2026

To participate and be eligible for Global Judging, you must first register for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. You can register up until the hackathon closes on November 15.

Register

Step 03

## CHOOSE A LOCAL EVENT

August 26, 2026

Connect with the NASA Space Apps community by choosing an in-person or virtual Local Event near you. If you don’t have a Local Event near you, choose the virtual Universal Event. You can choose or change your event up until the hackathon closes on November 15.

Choose a Local Event

Step 04

## JOIN OR FORM A TEAM

September 17, 2026

Collaborate with participants by forming or joining a team according to your chosen challenge. Teams should have no more than six participants. You can choose or change your team up until the hackathon closes on November 15.

Browse Teams

Step 05

## SUBMIT A PROJECT

November 15, 2026

To edit and submit your project, go to the Project Tab on your Team’s page. Project submission opens on Saturday, November 14 at 9:00 AM and closes on Sunday, November 15 at 11:59 PM local time. Submit your project to receive a participant certificate and to be eligible for Global Judging. We encourage all participants to submit what they accomplish over the course of the hackathon.

Step 06

## Complete the Participant Survey

November 30, 2026

Share your feedback about your hackathon journey to help improve future events.

## Global Collaborators

NASA Space Apps Challenge Global Collaborators are companies or organizations that provide free tools and resources, called Global Offers, to support participants in the creation of their projects.

### Regístrate

  1. Tu registro oficial: Inicia sesión en spaceappschallenge.org y asegúrate de seleccionar San Salvador como tu Local Event. Este paso es obligatorio para poder competir.
  2. Atención a tu correo: Mantente atento a tu bandeja de entrada para recibir información de seguimiento sobre tu inscripción.
  3. Formación de equipos (A partir del 17 de septiembre): Ya podrás elegir el desafío que resolverás y formar tu equipo (de 1 a 6 integrantes).
  4. El Hackathon (14 y 15 de noviembre): ¡A trabajar! Participa en modalidad presencial o virtual y desarrolla tu proyecto junto a tu equipo.
  5. Entrega final (15 de noviembre): Sube tu proyecto terminado a la plataforma oficial (spaceappschallenge.org) antes de las 11:59 p.m. (hora local).

### Qué más tenemos para ti

  * Diploma de participación oficial de NASA Space Apps Challenge
  * Reconocimiento a proyectos destacados con premios locales
  * Sesiones informativas, mentoría y experiencias interactivas

### How to Participate

  * Your official registration: Log in to spaceappschallenge.org and make sure to select San Salvador as your Local Event. This step is mandatory to compete.
  * Keep an eye on your email: Watch your inbox for tracking information regarding your registration.
  * Team formation (Starting September 17): You will be able to choose the challenge you will solve and form your team (1 to 6 members).
  * The Hackathon (November 14 and 15): Time to work! Participate in-person or virtually and develop your project with your team.
  * Final submission (November 15): Upload your finished project to the official platform (spaceappschallenge.org) before 11:59 p.m. (local time).

### What We Offer

  * Official NASA Space Apps Challenge participation certificate
  * Local awards and recognition for outstanding projects
  * Information sessions, mentorship, and interactive activities
  * Networking opportunities with industry leaders, educators, and fellow innovators
  * Direct access to open data and exclusive tools from NASA and partner space agencies

Further details regarding the agenda, judging panel, sponsors, and prizes will be announced soon. Stay tuned!

> This is your opportunity to join a global movement of problem-solvers building solutions for Earth and space.

## User-Generated Content

This page contains content originally written, designed, or submitted by a Space Apps participant or Local Lead and may not have been reviewed by a NASA team member prior to publication. If you believe this content violates the Space Apps Terms & Conditions, please contact info@spaceappschallenge.org.

Virtual

In-Person

Accepting Participants

NASA Space Apps Challenge Faisalabad 2026
Hybrid event: join online or onsite

The Basics
NASA Space Apps Challenge is a global hackathon run by NASA. In 48 hours, teams use free space data from NASA and other space agencies to solve real problems on Earth and in space. This year’s theme is “The Next Frontier”.

Our Faisalabad event runs on November 14–15, 2026. It is a hybrid event:

  * Onsite: join us at Superior University (Faisalabad Campus).
  * Online: join from home on Zoom and Discord.

Both groups work on the same challenges and follow the same rules. The event starts at 9:00 AM (Pakistan time) on November 14.

Why Join?

  * Build a real project in a team and learn by doing
  * Work with real NASA data
  * Practice teamwork, problem solving and presenting
  * Get help from mentors
  * Add a project to your CV or portfolio
  * Meet students and professionals from Faisalabad and take part in a global event

The event is free and open to students, developers, designers and anyone who loves space and technology. You do not need to be an expert. Beginners are welcome.

How to Join

  1. Register on this page. You must register here first. Registration closes on November 15.
  2. Choose how you will attend: onsite or online.
  3. Form a team of 1 to 6 people(Team of 4 is best), or find teammates in our Discord.
  4. Join our Discord and LinkedIn page for all updates.
  5. Pick one of the NASA challenges and start building on November 14. Please do not start before 9:00 AM that day.
  6. Submit your project on the Space Apps website by 11:59 PM on November 15 (Pakistan time).

Schedule

  * Nov 14: Check-in (onsite) and Zoom orientation, team formation, then hacking with mentor support
  * Nov 15: Hacking continues, closing ceremony, final submission by 11:59 PM
  * Nov 16–20: Judging
  * After judging: Local results announced

See the Local Event Schedule tab for exact times.

Judges and Awards
Local judges will review every project. They will score on Impact, Creativity, Validity, Relevance and Presentation.

There is no cash prize at this event. Top projects may also be nominated for NASA’s Global Judging.
Official Certificates will be provided to all teams that submit project on time.

## 🇺🇸 ENGLISH VERSION

### NASA Space Apps Challenge Uberlândia 2026

November 14–15, 2026 · Uberlândia, Minas Gerais, Brazil · In-person event

Welcome to the official page of NASA Space Apps Challenge Uberlândia — the world's largest hackathon, running simultaneously in hundreds of cities and, here, in the heart of Brazil's Triângulo Mineiro region.

For 48 hours, students, developers, designers, scientists, entrepreneurs and curious minds come together to solve real challenges posed by NASA and its partner agencies, using open data about space and about our own planet. You don't need to be a scientist or work in tech — you just need to want to build something.

#### 🚀 Why join

  * Real challenges, real data. Work with open data from NASA and partner space agencies to tackle genuine problems — from climate to space exploration.
  * Global reach. The top teams from Uberlândia are nominated for global judging at the NASA Space Apps Challenge, competing with projects from around the world.

Saturday, November 14 Official opening, challenge briefing, team formation and validation, kickoff and mentoring rounds.

Sunday, November 15 Development continues, project submission on the official platform, pitches to the judging panel, awards and closing ceremony.

The detailed agenda will be published on our website and social media.

* * *

#### 📍 Venue

ESAMC Uberlândia — Avenue Vasconcelos Costa, 270 - Martins, Uberlândia - MG, 38400-448

Expected facilities: dedicated team workspaces, high-speed internet, rest areas, food service and mentoring rooms.

#### 👥 Who can take part

The NASA Space Apps Challenge is open to all ages! However, participants who are under the age of 18 must be registered for the event by a parent or legal guardian and must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian at all times during the event, from any background. Teams have 1 to 6 members and can be formed before or during the event — we run a matchmaking session for those arriving solo.

Skills that make a difference on a team: programming, data and AI, design and UX, sciences (physics, astronomy, biology, meteorology), engineering, communication, business and storytelling.

## Welcome to NASA Space Apps Rome 2026

Join us in Rome, Italy, on 14-15 November 2026 for the NASA Space Apps Challenge - a global hackathon that brings together students, researchers, engineers, developers, scientists, designers, entrepreneurs, storytellers, and space enthusiasts to create innovative solutions to challenges on Earth and in space using NASA and partner open data.

### Who can participate?

Everyone is welcome. You do not need to be a space expert or an experienced programmer.

We especially encourage participation from people interested in:

  * Software development and programming
  * AeroSpace, Mechanical and Mechatronics engineering
  * Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
  * Engineering and Robotics
  * Earth Observation and Environmental Science
  * Space Science and Technology
  * Biomedical Engineering and Space Health
  * Design and UX/UI
  * Entrepreneurship and Innovation
  * Communication, Media, and Storytelling

Participants are encouraged to register early and follow the Rome Local Event page for important updates.

### Event information

📅 Dates: 14-15 November 2026
📍 Location: Rome, Italy
Participation fee: Free
Working language: English, with Italian support.

### Mentors and local community

Participants will have the opportunity to interact with mentors and experts from different fields, including science, engineering, technology, artificial intelligence, data analysis, design, innovation, and entrepreneurship.

### Before the event

We are planning additional activities to help participants prepare for the hackathon, including:

  * Welcome and orientation session
  * Team formation support
  * Challenge discovery
  * Open-data guidance
  * Mentoring
  * Pitch and project-submission preparation

## Judging

How Will Projects Be Evaluated?

Projects submitted through the official NASA Space Apps Challenge process are evaluated using five core criteria:

Impact, Creativity, Validity, Relevance, and Presentation.

These criteria allow judges to evaluate a project not only on the solution itself, but also on its significance, originality, technical or scientific foundation, connection to the selected challenge, and ability to communicate its ideas effectively.

Projects submitted through the official process are first evaluated locally. Selected projects can then advance as Global Nominees for consideration during the global judging process.

# 2026 NASA SPACE APPS CHALLENGE
## REGISTER TODAY

On **November 14-15, 2026**, NASA and 17 Space Agency Partners invite scientists, technologists, and space science enthusiasts to participate in the **2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge**. Over the course of two days, teams will develop projects that address challenges using NASA’s open data and space-based data from Space Agency Partners.

With this year’s theme **the Next Frontier:**

- Develop tools that benefit humanity and contribute to the science and technology propelling us to the Moon, Mars, and beyond
- Be a leader in your city’s STEM communities
- Use NASA’s open data to address the most pressing challenges in Earth and space exploration to spark innovation

## 2026 Space Agency Partners
